title: raman-turnover-benchmark: a synthetic benchmark for inverting the Raman crystallite-size turnover in nanocrystalline graphite (code and evaluation records)
description:
Code and evaluation records for Resolving the Raman crystallite size turnover in nanocrystalline graphite with a synthetic benchmark (R. J. York, preprint v2.0, 2026-09-05). The disorder ratio I(D)/I(G) of carbon Raman spectra is not invertible: it rises as 1/La to a turnover near 20 Å and falls as La2 beyond it. The repository holds the generator of a deterministic synthetic corpus built on that forward model (3,400 spectra at 325, 514 and 633 nm with planted acquisition failures; seed 3407), the five benchmark tasks, the physics baseline and learned inversion pipelines scored on it, the probes, the release-gate verifier, and an append-only Ed25519 ledger tool. All results are modelled: they are outputs of a declared forward model and make no claim about physical films.

Release v2.0 pins the code at the state re-derived on three independent environments (macOS pinned, Linux sandbox, GitHub Actions pinned) with the release gates reporting PASS, adds a test suite and a continuous re-derivation workflow, and documents the scikit-learn-version drift of the learned model. The corpus, per-row metadata and evaluation records are deposited separately (data record, CC BY 4.0); the preprint PDF is attached to this release.
notes: Preprint PDF SHA-256 1a15d3be94756c91e47bd18e8c9be7c30ab2d7a0598b52a7b4515d33ef43ed02 is the digest printed on the author's Publications page; corpus digest 604e9bf48a5f2d4b81782b4efa7696fa32010cfd069e6a6db8521b118bd37120 identifies the deposited file and is build-specific (see README, Independent re-derivations).
